input: Draft a volunteer agreement for my nonprofit board

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Volunteer Agreement for Your Nonprofit Board
gold.taskDescription: Create a formal volunteer agreement document tailored to the user's nonprofit board members.

questions.title: What is your nonprofit's name and mission focus?
questions.description: Understand the organization's identity and purpose to tailor the agreement's language and context.

questions.title: Are these volunteers board members or general volunteers?
questions.description: Clarify the exact role the agreement is intended for, since board members have distinct legal and governance responsibilities compared to general volunteers.

questions.title: What specific commitments must volunteers fulfill?
questions.description: Identify time requirements, meeting attendance, fundraising goals, or other duties to include in the agreement.

questions.title: What is the term or duration of the volunteer role?
questions.description: Determine whether the agreement covers a fixed term, a single event, or an ongoing open-ended period.

questions.title: Which state or country will govern this agreement legally?
questions.description: Identify the applicable jurisdiction so the agreement uses correct legal language and complies with local nonprofit law.

questions.title: Do you need a confidentiality or non-disclosure clause included?
questions.description: Determine whether volunteers will handle sensitive information requiring a formal confidentiality obligation in the agreement.

questions.title: Does an attorney need to review this before it is used?
questions.description: Establish whether the draft is a starting point for legal review or a final ready-to-sign document, which affects the level of legal precision required.
